title: bourreria rotata
intro: Bourreria rotata, commonly known as the "Tropical Sage", is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae, native to tropical regions of Central and South America. The Tropical Sage has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress, as well as promoting better sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Bourreria rotata are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, exerting sedative and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
